d:
Kanasalli Bandavanare Is A Beautiful Evergreen Kannada Audio Song From The Classic Movie Shruthi Seridaga, Featuring The Legendary Dr. Rajkumar And Madhavi. The Melodious Music Is Composed By Renowned Music Director T.G. Lingappa.
Enjoy The Nostalgic Beauty Of Kanasalli Bandavanare And Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema. A Timeless Classic For Fans Of Dr. Rajkumar Songs, Old Kannada Songs, Evergreen Melodies And Classic Kannada Movie Music.
Directed by: Chi. Dattaraj
Produced by: Raghavendra Rajkumar
Written by: Singeetam Srinivasa Rao, Chi. Udaya Shankar
